titleEn: Construct Target Array With Multiple Sums
title: 多次求和构造目标数组
summary: 从全一数组出发，每次把一个位置替换为当前数组总和，判断能否得到 target。
insight: 逆向恢复时只有最大值可能是最后被替换的位置。其替换前的值等于 max 对其余元素和 rest 取模；用最大堆反复恢复。
pitfalls: rest 为一时一定能继续恢复
余数为零、rest 不小于最大值或 rest 为零时无解

solutions.title: 最大堆逆向恢复
solutions.idea: 每次把当前最大值批量还原到对其余和取模后的前驱值。
steps: 将 target 放入最大堆并计算 total
取 max，令 rest=total-max；max 或 rest 为一时成功，非法状态时失败
previous=max%rest，更新 total 并把 previous 放回堆

complexity.time: O(n log n + log M log n)

code.java: class Solution { public boolean isPossible(int[] target){PriorityQueue<Long> heap=new PriorityQueue<>(Collections.reverseOrder());long total=0;for(int value:target){heap.offer((long)value);total+=value;}while(true){long maximum=heap.poll(),rest=total-maximum;if(maximum==1||rest==1)return true;if(rest==0||rest>=maximum||maximum%rest==0)return false;long previous=maximum%rest;total=rest+previous;heap.offer(previous);}} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun isPossible(target:IntArray):Boolean{val heap=java.util.PriorityQueue<Long>(reverseOrder());var total=0L;for(value in target){heap.add(value.toLong());total+=value};while(true){val maximum=heap.remove();val rest=total-maximum;if(maximum==1L||rest==1L)return true;if(rest==0L||rest>=maximum||maximum%rest==0L)return false;val previous=maximum%rest;total=rest+previous;heap.add(previous)}} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: bool isPossible(vector<int>& target){priority_queue<long long> heap;long long total=0;for(int value:target){heap.push(value);total+=value;}while(true){long long maximum=heap.top();heap.pop();long long rest=total-maximum;if(maximum==1||rest==1)return true;if(rest==0||rest>=maximum||maximum%rest==0)return false;long long previous=maximum%rest;total=rest+previous;heap.push(previous);}} };
